title: VENTURE WITHIN
summary: To venture within is the first step of remembering: a space to dream and allow your imagination to guide you on the path of rebuilding and the longing for home. It is a journey inside the memories and stories that reminds us of the precious history and cultural heritage that forms the foundation of who we are.

project.title: Venture Within
project.brief:
To celebrate the opening of the new Hermès flagship store at 166 New Bond Street, Njoya Studios was invited to create the window installations across the UK stores.

Born from the conceptual theme of L’appel du large, the studio created the series Venture Within. This story is about the very moment your mind and body calls for a return home, when L’appel du large becomes the exploration of the self. It takes place in our deeper consciousness, a space where reality and dreams converge to recreate a memory of home. The dream world shows us fragments of our own lived experience.

closingParagraphs: Having left my homeland at a very young age with no idea when I might return, this project gives me the opportunity to venture beyond and within myself to relive my own past. The castle tree, for example, came as a representation of home, where everything nourishes and grows magically - the center of the origin of life and all knowledge. This project is about remembering my people, my culture, and the stories of my ancestors. This is an open letter to those who have left their home with no prospect of return. This is a reminder that home is always with you, and you can find your way back.
